# panoscool

> Lavdimir K. (panoscool), a software engineer in Dubai working on e-commerce sites with TypeScript, React and Next.js. Personal projects include web apps, browser games, and JavaScript packages.

## Apps

- [hmlx](https://hmlx.app): Track personal and household expenses in multiple currencies, split bills, and record repayments. Paid plans add budgets and forecasts.
- [Truth or Dare](https://tord.panoscool.com): Play as a guest on one device, or sign in for private rooms with friends on separate phones and custom truths and dares.
- [Blank Quest](https://blankquest.netlify.app): A keyboard-friendly hangman word game.

## Packages

- [@panoscool/fetch-client](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@panoscool/fetch-client): A typed fetch client with interceptors, JSON handling, and structured errors.
- [@panoscool/query-string](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@panoscool/query-string): URL query string parsing and serialisation with configurable array formats.
